name: echo
description: Echo monorepo: NestJS API and React web app

scripts.build: npm run build -w @echo/api && npm run build -w @echo/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @echo/api && npm run lint -w @echo/web
scripts.check: npm run lint -w @echo/api && npm test -w @echo/api && npm run check -w @echo/web
